inputs.name: HubApiController.constructor.runtime
inputs.description: The runtime bundle that the controller keeps as its private field and reads while handling requests: auth.handle(request), whose truthy result is returned as the response; auth.actor(request), whose falsy result produces a 401; connect(), whose api and projection services are used on /api/projects routes; and the remote and agent members, which are passed to HubRemoteController and used as the executor on project routes. The constructor performs no checks, so a missing or wrong member can only fail later, inside handle, where the error is caught and returned through hubHttpFailure.

inputs.name: HubApiController.handle.request
inputs.description: The incoming Fetch Request, passed unchanged to runtime.auth.handle, runtime.auth.actor and the route code that reads its URL pathname and method. The pathname is split on '/' and each segment goes through decodeURIComponent, so a malformed percent-escape is caught inside handle and passed to hubHttpFailure; a second segment of 'remote' goes to HubRemoteController, other paths whose first two segments are not 'api' and 'projects' get a 404, and GET selects the read branch while any other method selects the mutation branch.

outputs.name: HubApiController.handle
outputs.description: Returns the response from authentication or the applicable collaboration or remote route. Authenticated owner discovery returns an empty collection if collaboration is disabled. Other missing settings, denials and routing failures keep their coded HTTP status.

outputs.name: HubApiController.handle
outputs.description: The Response that handle resolves with: the result of runtime.auth.handle when that result is truthy, a 401 hubHttp({ error: 'session-required' }) when runtime.auth.actor returns a falsy value, and otherwise the Response of the matched route, such as a 404 hubHttp({ error: 'not-found' }) or a 405 hubHttp({ error: 'method-denied' }). Errors raised while routing are caught and returned through hubHttpFailure rather than thrown out of handle.

outputs.name: HubApiController.constructor
outputs.description: The HubApiController instance that new HubApiController(runtime) produces, holding only the private runtime field. The constructor body is empty, so it does no validation or setup beyond storing that field.
